_comment: Two DIRECTORIES, not a list of the windows inside them. This listed renderer subdirectories one by one and had drifted twice: coverage and preview were never added, so a whole window was written against no compiler. An allowlist that has to be extended every time somebody adds a window is a list nothing checks for completeness. Naming the parent derives it instead. Separately: the root config excludes this app's main / preload / renderer so its pure-Node program skips them, and `exclude` is INHERITED through `extends` and resolved against the ROOT, so without the override below it also excluded everything here and these two programs silently checked nothing but src/shared.
